The Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) As Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: DS/VN/L.ACQ/UDA2021. Land Ministry No.: 4-3/14/2021/UDA/350. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: Cadastral Map No. : 910247, Block 03, Sheet 1 Province : Northern District : Jaffna Divisional Secretariat Division : Valikamam North, Tellippalai Grama Niladhari Division : Naguleswaram J/226) Village : Naguleswaram Purpose : Urban Development Activities

Lot No. 1 Name of land: Not known; Description: Garden contains Eight permanent buildings, Two parts of permanent buildings, three foundations, Seven temporary sheds, One pool and One pond; Name of Claimant (Taken over under Proviso (a) to 38 of the land Acquisition Act): State; Original Claimant: Not known; Extent: 8.1410 Hectares. Lot No. 2 Name of land: Aalvanmalaiyady and Velarkadu; Description: Garden contains a masonry Well; Name of Claimant (Taken over under Proviso (a) to 38 of the land Acquisition Act): State; Original Claimant: Subramaniyam Rajendram and wife Vijayakumari; Extent: 0.2571 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Tellippalai on the 4th day of November 2024 at 9.00 a.m., and hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 28th day of October 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
